say:1:1034406001:1.text: "Dancing Together", a book about how to dance to please the Deer Spirit.
say:1:1034406001:1.source_cn: 《共舞》，一本讲述如何跳出取悦鹿灵舞蹈的书。
say:1:1034406001:1.male: "Dancing Together", a book about how to dance to please the Deer Spirit.
say:1:1034406001:1.female: "Dancing Together", a book about how to dance to please the Deer Spirit.

say:2:1034406002:1.text: It details the steps that dancers perform on Prayer Day.
say:2:1034406002:1.source_cn: 书中详细介绍了祈福日舞娘的舞蹈舞步。
say:2:1034406002:1.male: It details the steps that dancers perform on Prayer Day.
say:2:1034406002:1.female: It details the steps that dancers perform on Prayer Day.

say:3:1034406003:1.text: I believe if I practice these steps with care, I can become one of the dancers one day.
say:3:1034406003:1.source_cn: 我相信只要在读过这本书之后勤加练习，我也可以成为祈福日...
say:3:1034406003:1.male: I believe if I practice these steps with care, I can become one of the dancers one day.
say:3:1034406003:1.female: I believe if I practice these steps with care, I can become one of the dancers one day.

say:4:1034406004:1.text: Just the thought of being able to dance for the Deer Spirit makes me so excited!
say:4:1034406004:1.source_cn: 一想到我也能为鹿灵献上舞蹈，我的内心就激动异常。
say:4:1034406004:1.male: Just the thought of being able to dance for the Deer Spirit makes me so excited!
say:4:1034406004:1.female: Just the thought of being able to dance for the Deer Spirit makes me so excited!
